selector.rationale: The presence of a pearly lesion and biopsy results showing nodular and infiltrative BCC patterns support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Anophthalmic Socket Syndrome
rejected.why: While the patient has an anophthalmic socket, the primary issue is the lesion on the eyelid, which is more consistent with BCC

rejected.label: Cicatricial Ectropion
rejected.why: Although the patient has cicatricial effects causing conjunctival shrinkage and eyelid skin contracture, the primary diagnosis is BCC, which is causing these secondary effects
